display.purpose: Hero h1, and every section h2/h3 headline, always at font-extrabold (800).

title.purpose: Sub-heading inside a stage (service/process/project item titles, Profile sub-sections).

label.purpose: Status pills, stage numbers, field labels, tags, category labels, nav.

motion.name: hero-entrance
motion.purpose: One-time hero reveal on load; skipped under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: list-detail-crossfade
motion.purpose: Detail panel swap in the List+Detail component on tab selection.

motion.name: stage-pulse
motion.value: opacity 1->0.4, scale 1->0.7, 1.8s ease-in-out infinite (keyframe defined in globals.css)
motion.purpose: Signature live-motion detail: the active pipeline-stage marker's inner dot breathes to read as 'currently running'; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion via the global animation-duration clamp.

motion.name: accent-cascade
motion.value: transition-colors duration-500 on every consumer of --color-accent/--color-accent-soft/--color-accent-bg
motion.purpose: Smooth 500ms hue crossfade as the visitor scrolls between the 8 stage accent triplets defined in accent-palette.ts, applied via a StageProvider inline CSS-custom-property wrapper.

components.name: Primary CTA Button
components.description: The 'Book a call' dispatch action; the only large-format use of the currently-active stage accent as a fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; background: var(--color-accent, #4f46e5); color: #ffffff; font-family: var(--font-geist-mono), ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 12px 24px; transition: background-color 0.5s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-accent-soft, #4338ca); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #4f46e5); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Form Submit Button
components.description: Contact-form submit: ink at rest, shifts to the active stage accent on hover (the one inverted button variant).
components.css: .ds-btn-submit { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; background: #111111; color: #ffffff; font-family: var(--font-geist-mono), ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 12px 24px; border: none; transition: background-color 0.5s; } .ds-btn-submit:hover { background: var(--color-accent, #4f46e5); } .ds-btn-submit:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Contact-form field: hairline border, accent-colored focus border, mono uppercase label above.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-field-label { font-family: var(--font-geist-mono), ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #6b6862; } .ds-field-input { border: 1px solid #e4e2dd; background: #ffffff; color: #111111; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; outline: none; } .ds-field-input:focus { border-color: var(--color-accent, #4f46e5); }

components.name: Stage Status Pill
components.description: Drawn SVG marker (ring/ring+dot/filled-check) plus mono tabular-nums label, e.g. '01/8 · init'. Marker shape carries status; color follows whichever stage accent is currently active. The active marker's inner dot carries the stage-pulse animation. Never a unicode glyph.
components.html: 01/8 · init
components.css: .ds-status-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: var(--font-geist-mono), ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--color-accent, #4f46e5); transition: color 0.5s; } .ds-status-label { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .stage-pulse { animation: stage-pulse 1.8s ease-in-out infinite; transform-origin: center; }

components.name: List + Detail
components.description: Signature two-column tab/panel pattern (Services, Process, Selected Work). Selection cue is font-weight + color only; no stripe, fill, or icon.
components.css: .ds-list-detail { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 280px 1fr; gap: 40px; } .ds-list-detail-row { cursor: pointer; border-top: 1px solid #e4e2dd; padding: 16px 4px; color: #55534e; text-align: left; background: none; } .ds-list-detail-row:first-child { border-top: none; } .ds-list-detail-row--selected { font-weight: 500; color: #111111; }

components.name: Tech Brand Mark
components.description: Monochrome (currentColor) inline SVG brand mark from the simple-icons catalog, shown next to a Selected Work stack tag only when a real catalog entry exists for that technology (Node.js, TypeScript, React, PostgreSQL, Sentry, Jest, GitHub Actions, i18next). No mark is fabricated for uncovered tools; they stay plain text.
components.html: TypeScript
components.css: .ds-tech-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: var(--font-geist-mono), ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #55534e; } .ds-tech-logo { width: 14px; height: 14px; color: #111111; }

narrative.overview:
The homepage is a CI/CD run, not a scrolling brochure: a fixed status header and a numbered left-hand stage rail track the visitor's progress through eight pipeline stages (init → build:services → build:ai → pipeline → deploy → profile → docs → dispatch) as they scroll. The surface is a near-white build log — paper and hairline dividers, Bricolage Grotesque extrabold display headlines, Hanken Grotesk prose, Geist Mono for anything that reads as machine output (status, numbers, labels, nav) — with an accent that shifts hue stage by stage (indigo → violet → fuchsia → rose → amber → emerald → cyan → indigo again at dispatch, closing the loop), cascaded through a CSS custom-property wrapper and cross-fading with a 500ms color transition as the visitor scrolls. The shifting hue reads as mood/momentum; it never breaks status semantics — queued/active/passed is still carried by the drawn marker shape, never by which color is currently live.

The system is flat by construction: no shadows, no blur, no glass anywhere in the build. Depth and hierarchy come from hairline borders (--color-line), color (ink vs. muted vs. faint), and weight, never from elevation. Selection and state are communicated by font-weight and color shifts alone.

Revised twice since the original build. First (token-level): signal-green accent to electric indigo, Unbounded display face added. Second, at explicit follow-up request: relaxed the forced full-viewport section height and mandatory scroll-snap; changed display/body pairing again (Unbounded to Bricolage Grotesque at explicit extrabold weight, Geist Sans to Hanken Grotesk); replaced the single static accent with an eight-stage animated accent cascade; merged Philosophy, Why-Me, and the bio into one Profile stage; added real monochrome tech-brand marks and a grayscale bio photo; swept cursor-pointer across every custom interactive element. Structure, copy voice, and the flat/no-shadow/drawn-icon system were left untouched by both revisions.
keyCharacteristics: Accent shifts per pipeline stage (indigo → violet → fuchsia → rose → amber → emerald → cyan → indigo), not one fixed site-wide hue; queued/active/passed status is always carried by marker shape, never by the current hue.
Bricolage Grotesque, set extrabold (800), for every h1/h2/h3 display headline; Hanken Grotesk for body/paragraph copy; Geist Mono for status pills, stage numbers, metadata/tag labels, and nav only.
Fully flat: hairline 1px borders, zero shadows, zero backdrop-blur.
Drawn SVG stage markers (hollow ring / ring+dot / filled check) — never unicode glyphs or emoji; the active marker's inner dot carries the stage-pulse live-motion signature.
List+detail is the signature content pattern across Services, Process, and Selected Work.

rules.name: The Accent-Per-Stage Rule
rules.body: accent-palette.ts defines eight {accent, soft, bg} triplets (indigo, violet, fuchsia, rose, amber, emerald, cyan, indigo) at ~Tailwind-700 depth (≥4.5:1 on white as text). StageProvider writes the active stage's triplet onto --color-accent/--color-accent-soft/--color-accent-bg on an inline-styled wrapper div; every consumer transitions with transition-colors duration-500 so the hue drifts rather than snaps between stages.

rules.name: The Shape-Carries-Status Rule
rules.body: The stage marker's drawn shape (hollow ring = queued, ring+dot = active, filled check = passed) is the only carrier of pipeline status. The cascading accent hue is mood/momentum only and must never be read as a status signal.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Whichever hue is currently live is reserved for "passed," "active," and the dispatch action within that stage. It never decorates a card, a divider, or a heading; if nothing has completed or isn't actionable, the element stays ink/muted/faint.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-Machine-Output Rule
rules.body: Mono type marks anything that reads as system-generated: counters, statuses, tags, labels, and nav. Body copy stays Hanken Grotesk.

rules.name: The Display-Is-Headline Rule
rules.body: Bricolage Grotesque, always at font-extrabold, is reserved for h1/h2/h3 structural headings only, applied via the shared --font-display token; it never appears in body prose or labels.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Nothing in this system casts a shadow or sits behind blur. A divider is a 1px hairline; a raised surface does not exist as a device.

dos: Do cascade --color-accent/--color-accent-soft/--color-accent-bg per pipeline stage via accent-palette.ts + StageProvider, transitioning consumers with transition-colors duration-500; reserve whichever hue is currently live for that stage's passed/active state and CTA — never as a background wash or decorative border.
Do carry pipeline status (queued/active/passed) exclusively through the drawn marker shape (hollow ring / ring+dot / filled check); the cascading accent hue is mood only.
Do set status/label/number/nav copy in Geist Mono; keep headlines in Bricolage Grotesque at font-extrabold and body prose in Hanken Grotesk.
Do mark list/tab selection with font-medium + text-ink color change only — no stripe, no fill, no icon.
Do draw stage and status markers as stroked SVG (ring/ring+dot/filled-check); never substitute a unicode glyph or emoji.
Do keep the header and stage rail fully opaque with a 1px hairline border — no backdrop-blur or translucency.
Do set explicit cursor-pointer on every custom-styled interactive control (buttons, button-like anchors, toggles); Tailwind v4 does not default this.
Do attach a real brand mark (via TechLogo.tsx/simple-icons) only when the catalog has a genuine entry for that technology; leave everything else as plain text.
Do reserve the stage-pulse live-pulse animation for the single active-stage marker dot; it is not a general-purpose attention effect.
donts: Don't introduce a box-shadow, glow, or backdrop-blur anywhere; the system's depth model is flat-plus-hairline, full stop.
Don't add a colored side-stripe border to a list row, card, or callout to indicate selection or category — weight/color is the only cue this system uses.
Don't mask the Profile-stage headshot (or any future portrait) into a circle or other geometric cutout; the shipped shape is rounded-2xl, and it renders grayscale.
Don't let the cascading accent hue double as a status signal; status is shape-only.
Don't use Bricolage Grotesque for body copy or labels; it is a headline-only display face, and always at font-extrabold when used.
Don't fabricate a brand mark for a technology simple-icons doesn't carry; plain text is the correct fallback, not an invented glyph.
